summary: Repaired the rejected draft and resubmitted it. Changes: dropped the unsupported note fields from sources, corrected the state.go citation (file has 174 lines), widened the installSnapshot and appendEntries source ranges so each contains a verifiable Go declaration, replaced the requirement's anchors with three symbol-anchored declarations (installSnapshot, getLastEntry, appendEntries) resolved against the declared source ids, and removed the harness self-mapping from experiment.files. Read-only validation now reports valid with execution_requested: it creates the seven sources, three behavior entries, investigation @q_snapshot_install_stale_log, one interpretation and the two-case experiment (TestAssurance_StaleSuffixAfterInstallSnapshot plus the untrimmed control). Nothing else changed: the harness content, comparisons and the source-based defect account (a follower that accepts a snapshot while its cached last log entry is at or beyond the snapshot index keeps advertising that stale suffix, fails every prev-log check, and the leader degenerates into re-shipping the same snapshot) are unchanged, and the formal conclusion still awaits the retained receipt.
